name: Tickets
description: Service requests and IT tickets: intake, triage, assignment, resolution, and requester confirmation. 1.2.0 adds service requests: a catalog of requestable items with typed questions, fulfillment tasks with dependencies, and request and task workflows. 1.3.0 adds approvals: approval policies with stages, an Approver role, and requests that wait for approval before fulfillment. 1.4.0 publishes ticket events (escalated, priority raised, resolved) that notifications, alerts and integrations can subscribe to, and adds an Escalate action. 1.5.0 adds service levels: a service desk business calendar, response and resolution targets for tickets, a fulfillment target for requests and a completion target for tasks.

entities.label: Ticket
entities.description: A request for help or service raised by a requester and worked by agents.

fields.label: Number
fields.description: Human-friendly ticket ID, unique per environment.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: One-line summary of the request or problem.

fields.label: Impact

entities.label: Request
entities.description: A request for something from the service catalog, such as a laptop or access to an application. Fulfillment tasks do the work.

fields.label: Number
fields.description: Human-friendly request ID, unique per environment.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: Defaults to the catalog item name.

fields.label: Catalog item
fields.description: What was requested. Cannot change after the request is created.

fields.label: Request details
fields.description: The requester's answers to the catalog item's questions.

fields.label: Approvers
fields.help: People and groups asked to approve this request. Maintained by the platform.

fields.label: Fulfillment outcome

entities.label: Fulfillment task
entities.description: One piece of work that fulfills a request. Tasks wait for the tasks they depend on.
